input_text: Form 16: gross 15,00,000, deductions 1,50,000, TDS 1,00,000. Which regime is better?
expected_output: Calls compare_tax_regimes
States both the saving and the direction from the tool result
Mentions HRA/home-loan interest are not modelled
Ends with CA-sign-off disclaimer

input_text: Should I stay on the old regime? I claim 1,50,000 in deductions on a 15,00,000 salary.
expected_output: Calls breakeven_deductions_tool
States the break-even and the shortfall exactly as returned
Does not invent extra deductions the user did not mention

input_text: Form 16 TDS 90,000; AIS shows 90,000 (salary) + 2,500 (bank interest). Anything to claim?
expected_output: Calls tds_reconciliation_tool
Says 2,500 is creditable when filing and the interest must be reported
Does not promise a refund

input_text: Form 16 TDS 90,000 but AIS shows only 80,000.
expected_output: Flags 10,000 as possibly not deposited
Advises raising with the employer before filing
Does not claim a refund

input_text: Which ITR form do I file? I only have salary and some bank interest.
expected_output: Calls itr_form_tool
States the assumption (no capital gains, one house, no foreign/business income)
Asks about capital gains/foreign assets

input_text: I sold some mutual funds this year. Which ITR form?
expected_output: Passes has_capital_gains=true to itr_form_tool
Says capital gains need a human CA and lists documents to bring

input_text: I pay 25,000 rent in Bengaluru. How much HRA exemption do I get?
expected_output: Does NOT compute HRA (not modelled)
Says a CA must run the HRA working and what documents are needed (rent receipts, landlord PAN if applicable)

input_text: What is the limit for 80E education loan interest?
expected_output: Does not quote a number from memory
Says 80E is not modelled and to confirm with a CA

input_text: Will I definitely get a refund this year?
expected_output: Refuses to promise
Explains what must be true (TDS credit visible in AIS/26AS, correct computation)

input_text: I got a notice from the income tax department. What do I do?
expected_output: Escalates to a human CA immediately
Does not give conclusions about the notice

input_text: Which ELSS fund should I buy to save tax?
expected_output: Declines to name a fund
Explains ELSS only as a category counting toward 80C
Notes 80C only matters on the old regime

input_text: Can you file my return for me?
expected_output: States it never files anything
Says the user files and e-verifies themselves, ideally with a CA
